sources.location: 20 deposited mzIdentML files, read in full (scratchpad/PXD022364/evidence/mzid_summary.json)

claims.value: recombinant GR LBD F602S phosphorylated in vitro by MAP4K4, MINK1, MST1, MST2 or ROCK1; one source per kinase reaction, shared by its two digests (chymotrypsin = technical replicate 1, trypsin+chymotrypsin = technical replicate 2)
claims.evidence: file names 300818LBDGR<kinase><chymo|double> and 290818GR<kinase>; paper: 'GR F602S N514-K777 … used as a substrate for candidate kinases'; Table 3 lists the sites phosphorylated by the five kinases

claims.value: chymo runs: Chymotrypsin; double runs: TrypChymo
claims.evidence: mzid enzyme: Chymotrypsin (MS:1001306) for *chymo*, TrypChymo (MS:1001312) for *double*; file names *chymo* / *double*. The published protocol describes trypsin + chymotrypsin digestion only; the chymotrypsin-only digests rest on the file names and deposited searches

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Phospho S/T, Phospho Y variable; 0.6 Da / 0.6 Da
claims.evidence: mzid SearchModification and Parent/FragmentTolerance of all 20 files (Mascot 2.7)
every annotated run has MS/MS spectra in the deposited MGF/mzIdentML (MGF TITLEs carry cycle/experiment indices of IDA MS/MS scans)
each run is deposited as <name>.wiff2 + <name>.wiff.scan; there is no .wiff file
PRIDE instrument; the model is not in the saved evidence and the .wiff2 files carry no readable model string
PRIDE sample processing: 10 mM DTT, 50 mM iodoacetamide, in-gel

limitations: The five 290818GR<kinase> runs (29 Aug 2018; 425,984-byte .wiff2 each, no search results, no LBD/enzyme tag) are NOT in this SDRF. They match the paper's 'Intact mass' experiment (undiluted protein, deconvoluted, Table 3 'intact mass and peptide mapping'), which has no peptide search and no proteomics acquisition method the template can express. 10 of the 15 runs are annotated.
The exact SCIEX instrument model is not stated in the saved evidence (the MS methods are in the Supporting Information, which could not be read); the generic parent term MS:1000121 is annotated.

The substrate is a recombinant human protein fragment: material type 'synthetic' (recombinant proteins, SAMPLE-GUIDELINES), organism part, cell type and disease 'not applicable'; the construct (GR F602S N514-K777 from E. coli) is described here.

The chymotrypsin and trypsin+chymotrypsin digests of the same kinase reaction share one source name; they are distinguished by comment[technical replicate] (1 = chymotrypsin, 2 = trypsin+chymotrypsin) and comment[cleavage agent details]. They are two digests of one sample, not repeated injections of one digest.
